capabilities: scan the active note for plain-text occurrences of other notes' titles and aliases
show a preview of every match with surrounding context before changing anything
convert confirmed matches into wikilinks pointing to the right notes
skip text inside frontmatter, code blocks, math, existing links, tags, and HTML comments
report and skip terms whose title or alias is ambiguous
disambiguation: Despite the manifest's wording, it edits only the currently open note, not every note in the vault.
extras: The README warns that edits are not reversible without a vault backup and recommends backing up before first use.
intentEvidence: When you write a note and mention another note by name without linking it, Obsidian calls that an "unlinked mention."
problem: Obsidian marks unlinked mentions in the backlinks pane, but turning each one into a wikilink by hand is tedious.
summary: Bulk-linking tool that converts plain-text mentions of other notes and their aliases in the active note into wikilinks, with a confirmable preview.
